subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should maintainers split this into a heartbeat wake precedence bugfix first, or also change Telegram DMs away from the documented default main-session behavior now?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence path is a concrete source-reproducible bug, but changing Telegram DM default routing affects documented compatibility for existing users who rely on main-session continuity.

options.title: Split Heartbeat Precedence First
options.body: Adopt or replace the linked PR with a narrower fix where explicit `heartbeat.session` wins for event wakes, leaving Telegram DM defaults under `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

options.title: Bundle Telegram Isolation
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default in the same work, accepting the upgrade and documentation impact for users relying on main-session sharing.

options.title: Defer Behind Scheduling Redesign
options.body: Hold this behind native per-session heartbeat scheduling, which may be cleaner long term but leaves the current forced-session contamination path unresolved longer.

recommendation.title: Split Heartbeat Precedence First
recommendation.body: Adopt or replace the linked PR with a narrower fix where explicit `heartbeat.session` wins for event wakes, leaving Telegram DM defaults under `session.dmScope` until a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger is the best available owner from the heartbeat/session history and the compatibility-sensitive routing decision.
